import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] m;

        Matrix() {
            m = new int[32][32];
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(m[i], 0);
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b, int k) {
            Matrix c = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= k; ++l) {
                        c.m[i][l] = (int)((c.m[i][l] + (long) m[i][j] * b.m[j][l]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (n > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(n % k));
            n /= k;
        }
        Collections.reverse(digits);

        int size = digits.size();

        Matrix[][] f = new Matrix[size + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                f[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        // Identity matrix
        Matrix identity = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                identity.m[i][j] = (i == j || i == 0 || j == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                f[i + 1][j] = new Matrix();
                for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(identity.m[r], 0, f[i + 1][j].m[r], 0, k + 1);
                }
                f[i + 1][j].m[j][j] = 1;
                f[i + 1][j].m[0][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix[] prefix = new Matrix[size + 1];
        Matrix[] suffix = new Matrix[size + 1];

        prefix[0] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            prefix[0].m[i][i] = 1;
        }

        suffix[size] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            suffix[size].m[i][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
            prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1].multiply(f[i][0], k);
        }

        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            suffix[i] = f[i + 1][0].multiply(suffix[i + 1], k);
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans.m[0][i] = 0;
        }
        ans.m[0][k] = 1;

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int limit = digits.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < limit; j++) {
                ans = ans.multiply(f[i + 1][(sum + j) % k], k);
            }
            sum = (sum + limit) % MOD;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            res = (res + ans.m[0][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
